visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a traditional Taiwanese street food stall with a large red banner featuring white characters. A female vendor wearing a pink mask and a brown apron with a bear design is standing behind the counter, while a customer in a purple shirt waits. (2) A close-up shot displays a sliced black pepper bun (Hujiao Bing) held in a hand, revealing a thick layer of seasoned ground meat and bright green chopped scallions encased in a sesame-covered crust. (3) The camera focuses on the vendor's hands as she expertly stuffs a thin piece of dough with a large spoonful of dark, seasoned pork and then packs in a generous amount of fresh green scallions from a large basket. (4) A large, golden-brown baked bun covered in white sesame seeds is shown held up against the shop background. (5) Another close-up of the halved bun highlights the juicy texture of the meat and the steam rising from the interior. (6) A metal tray filled with flat, oval-shaped biscuits is pulled from a rack, showing the varied baked goods available. (7) A small, round, flaky pastry is torn open to show multiple thin layers and a green onion filling inside. (8) An elongated sesame pastry is pulled apart to reveal a hollow, sweet-filled interior. (9) A close-up shows a cup of soy milk with a cartoon panda illustration on the lid, and a white straw is inserted into it. (10) Two pepper buns in paper bags are held up together in front of the shop. (11) The final scene shows the vendor bagging an order for a customer wearing a motorcycle helmet outside the stall, with text overlays providing the shop's address and name.
